description: This file defines the TimestreamInfluxDBClient class within the Aws\TimestreamInfluxDB namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for interacting with the Timestream InfluxDB service, including methods for creating, deleting, getting, listing, tagging, and updating database instances and parameters, with asynchronous equivalents.

classes.name: TimestreamInfluxDBClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Timestream InfluxDB AWS service, providing methods for managing database instances and parameters.

methods.name: createDbInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Timestream InfluxDB database instance.

methods.name: createDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Timestream InfluxDB database instance.

methods.name: createDbParameterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new database parameter group for Timestream InfluxDB.

methods.name: createDbParameterGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new database parameter group.

methods.name: deleteDbInstance
methods.description: Deletes an existing Timestream InfluxDB database instance.

methods.name: deleteDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a database instance.

methods.name: getDbInstance
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific database instance.

methods.name: getDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the details of a database instance.

methods.name: getDbParameterGroup
methods.description: Gets details of a specific database parameter group.

methods.name: getDbParameterGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a parameter group.

methods.name: listDbInstances
methods.description: Lists all Timestream database instances.

methods.name: listDbInstancesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all database instances.

methods.name: listDbParameterGroups
methods.description: Lists all database parameter groups.

methods.name: listDbParameterGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists parameter groups.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a specified resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateDbInstance
methods.description: Updates an existing database instance.

methods.name: updateDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a database instance.
